rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records across the import does not exceed 0.1% (accounts for school closures/mergers across biennial CRDC releases).
Ensures all StatVars within each survey-year input share the same latest observation date.
Ensures the 2024Onwards partition contains data for year 2024 or later.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS INT) AS latest_year FROM stats WHERE CAST(MinDate AS INT) >= 2024
